req.title: Redirect to arbitrary URL
req.statement: The system shall issue an HTTP 302 redirect to the URL given by the 'url' query parameter of /redirect-to.

doc.reasoning: The redirect_to() handler reads 'url' from query args, sets status_code=302 by default, and writes the exact URL string into the Location header. To maximise mutation kill rate I need to: (1) assert status_code == 302 exactly (catches constant mutations); (2) assert Location == the exact supplied URL string (catches string-copy mutations); (3) test with a custom 3xx status_code to cover the branch `if status_code >= 300 and status_code < 400`; (4) test boundary values 299 and 400 for the status_code guard (catches >= vs > and < vs <=); (5) test missing 'url' parameter (negative path, KeyError); (6) test a URL with special/unicode characters to verify UTF-8 encoding path; (7) test that a non-3xx status_code is ignored and 302 is returned.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_basic_302
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: status 302 and Location set to supplied url
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_basic_302():
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=https://example.com')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == 'https://example.com'

test_redirect_to_basic_302()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_location_exact_match
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: Location must equal the exact url query parameter value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_location_exact_match():
    target = 'http://httpbin.org/get'
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + target)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == target
    assert r.headers['Location'] != ''
    assert r.headers['Location'] != '/redirect-to'

test_redirect_to_location_exact_match()

expected: response raises a server-side error (5xx) or 400 because args['url'] KeyError

client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_missing_url_param():
    r = client.get('/redirect-to')
    assert r.status_code in (400, 500)
    assert r.status_code != 302

test_redirect_to_missing_url_param()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_unicode_url
expected: Location header contains the supplied URL
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: UTF-8 encoding path in handler; Location must reflect exact url value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
from urllib.parse import quote
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_unicode_url():
    raw_url = 'https://example.com/path?q=hello_world'
    encoded = quote(raw_url, safe='')
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + encoded)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert 'example.com' in r.headers['Location']
    assert r.headers['Location'] != ''

test_redirect_to_unicode_url()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_default_is_302_not_301_not_303
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: default status code constant is 302; catches constant mutation 302->301 or 302->303
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_default_is_302_not_301_not_303():
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=https://example.com')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.status_code != 301
    assert r.status_code != 303
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.headers['Location'] == 'https://example.com'

test_redirect_to_default_is_302_not_301_not_303()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_location_not_overwritten_by_default
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: Location must be the exact url param, not a default redirect path like /redirect/1
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_location_not_overwritten_by_default():
    target = 'https://target.example.org/deep/path'
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + target)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    loc = r.headers['Location']
    assert loc == target
    assert loc != '/redirect/1'
    assert loc != '/get'

test_redirect_to_location_not_overwritten_by_default()
